notes:
Renault Zoe phase 1, read over the diagnostic CAN on the OBD-II socket (11-bit identifiers at 500 kbit/s, ISO 15765-2, UDS).

The 15 units are every addressed row of the CanZE ZOE ECU file, each also present in the ddt4all address table with the same request and response identifiers. They sit on different internal buses (CanZE's network column: vehicle, EV, multimedia, options) and how the OBD socket's gateway forwards between them is not established, so a unit that does not answer may be unreachable from the socket rather than absent. Treat every row as unconfirmed on a given car until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering.

Session: CanZE gives 0xC0 as the start-session response for every Zoe unit, which is not a session this tool's read-only guard permits (it allows 0x01 and 0x03 only), so the profile opens the default session, 0x01. Whether a Zoe unit answers reads in the default session is unconfirmed.

Security gateway: a Renault security gateway is reported on recent cars, so a silent unit may be filtered rather than absent, and the tool reports a silent unit as no response, not as absent. A ddt4all issue (cedricp/ddt4all issue 404, Clio V, 2020) reports reads working through the OBD socket with writes blocked by a central gateway, and vendor pages (a Delphi article on a Renault Arkana, a Hella Gutmann page) say that fault codes and parameters can be read without unlocking it; none of them says which units a locked gateway hides from a read.
name: renault-zoe-ph1
description: Renault Zoe phase 1 (2012 to 2019), UDS over 11-bit CAN, address plan from CanZE and ddt4all

vin.source: The WMIs are the makers' car and SUV identifiers in the world manufacturer identifier table of the Wikipedia article Vehicle identification number, which cites the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt manufacturer list SV 3.2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261102120229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number). A WMI names the maker and plant, not the model, so a match only says the car is of a make this profile covers.
